description: Free. Counter a quote: give quote_id and your price (total in USD, or per unit with per_unit=true), optionally a different number of units. AETHER accepts, counters, or makes a final offer at its floor (at most 3 rounds). An agreed quote is paid through its pay links.

per_unit.description: true if price_usd is per unit.

quote_id.description: The quote id AETHER gave you, e.g. 'q_3f9a1c2b'.

units.description: Integer number of units you want quoted or bought, e.g. 10.

name: aether_negotiate
title: Counter-offer on a quote
